title: Dense ZZ Resource FFI
objective: Generate externally-accounted owned FLINT FmpzMatrix resources with safe construction, inspection, structural arithmetic, advanced exact algorithms, stable serialization, and lifecycle/performance tests

oracles: current packed dense ZZ matrix implementation

handoff.summary: Adds a generated, externally-accounted FmpzMatrix resource with always-valid zero-filled construction and checked mutation; direct copy, add/subtract/negate/scalar multiply, transpose, multiply, power, predicates, trace, rank, determinant, HNF, SNF, aligned formatting, and self-describing signed-magnitude serialization; and randomized, skew-memory, lifecycle-sanitizer, and cold/steady performance coverage.
risks: The resource target is intentionally wasm=False until the generated opaque-resource host adapter has a proven WebAssembly lowering.
HNF and SNF expose direct FLINT canonical forms but transformation matrices are deferred to a later multi-result resource protocol.
next_steps: Migrate dense ZZ public Matrix storage and operations to FmpzMatrix while retaining the packed implementation as the portable fallback and differential oracle.
Design right-kernel resource semantics together with the public lattice-basis normalization contract instead of freezing an incidental basis at this ABI layer.
Add a typed-Python borrowed traversal witness when the public dense ZZ migration establishes its kernel-facing API.
